recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further FHIR core source work is needed for FHIR-44858 unless a future work group decision reopens DiagnosticReport.encounter semantics; do not duplicate FHIR-48767 or FHIR-51687 because they are already represented on the combined branch.
issue_request: FHIR-44858 was Applied with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R6. OO approved a non-substantive clarification to DiagnosticReport.encounter: short description "Encounter associated with the DiagnosticReport", definition "The encounter (e.g. a patient and healthcare provider interaction) that is associated with the DiagnosticReport.", and a clarified comment about the encounter associated with reported tests and studies while keeping encounter optional.
initial_application: The seed was applied in source commit 1cdb5819e376f3604261c5255ee1dbe11ac8f175, which changed source/diagnosticreport/structuredefinition-DiagnosticReport.xml for DiagnosticReport.encounter short, definition, and comment. DiagnosticReport is active in source/fhir.ini, so the checked StructureDefinition source is in current build scope. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-44858 existed on the combined branch before this audit.
additional_context: Later Applied same-element issues explain the current differences from the literal FHIR-44858 resolution. FHIR-48767 intentionally refined the comment to describe the encounter, when it exists, where reported data or specimens were obtained/acquired and to use ServiceRequest.encounter through DiagnosticReport.basedOn for order association; FHIR-51687 intentionally corrected requirements from linking the request to linking the report to the Encounter context. Both related issues already have reconciliation commits on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because current source already retains FHIR-44858's short and definition changes, while the comment and requirements differences are due to later final OO decisions that should not be reverted.
